decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is a high-value specialized system that was released in 2019, serves a growing proton therapy market, and fits the firm's integrated QA platform strategy, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
Small volume chambers remain essential for small-field and stereotactic dosimetry, and having already pruned overlapping models in 2019, the firm is likely to keep this one as its core offering.
Standard clinical ionization chambers are a staple of absolute dosimetry tied to accredited calibration services, giving them long life cycles and steady demand.
Thimble chambers are established reference instruments with durable clinical demand and low maintenance cost, so the firm has little reason to discontinue them.
